IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'DimCustomer_CRM') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.DimCustomer_CRM;
END;

With Customer as(
	SELECT CUSTOMERID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId,SuspendedIndicator FROM BNKM.Customer WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'
),
CustomerTelephoneNumber as(
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimestamp desc  ) rn, CustomerId,TelephoneNumber,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000'
),
CustomerConsent as(
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY ConsentId  ) rn, CustomerId,ConsentId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM  BNKM.CustomerConsent
),
Consent as(
	SELECT DISTINCT ConsentId,ConsentName FROM BNKM.Consent
),
CustomerAction as(
	 SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CustomerAction A
	 JOIN (SELECT CustomerId ,CustomerActionTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode, MAX(CustomerActionTimestamp) CustomerActionTimestamp FROM BNKM.CustomerAction GROUP BY CustomerId ,CustomerActionTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode ) B
		ON A.CustomerId = B.CustomerId AND A.CustomerActionTypeId = B.CustomerActionTypeId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId
		AND A.SourceCode = B.SourceCode AND A.CustomerActionTimestamp = B.CustomerActionTimestamp
	WHERE A.SourceCode = 'CRM'
),
CustomerLocation as(
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimestamp desc ) rn, CustomerId,LocationId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerLocation WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000' 
),
Location as(
	SELECT LocationId,LocationAddressLine1,LocationAddressLine2,LocationZipCode,CountryId ,LocationCity,LocationStateId,FinancialInstitutionId  FROM BNKM.Location
),
CustomerEmail as(
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimestamp desc ) rn, CustomerId,EmailTypeId,EmailAddress,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail WHERE PreferenceId = 'Y' AND PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01'
),
City as(
	SELECT CityId,CityName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.City
),
STATE as(
	SELECT StateId,StateName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.[STATE]
),
CustomerEmployment as(
	SELECT row_number() over(partition by customerid,FinancialInstitutionId order by customerid,JobTitleId) rn, CustomerId,CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),EmployerId,1) EmployerId,JobTitleId,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE PeriodEndDate IS NULL
),
Employer as(
	SELECT row_number() over(partition by EmployerId,FinancialInstitutionId order by EmployerId,EmployerName) rn, EmployerId,EmployerName,EmployerAddressLine1,EmployerAddressLine2,CityId,StateId,ZipCode,Country,AnzsicClassCode,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.Employer
),
Country  as(
	SELECT CountryId,IsoCountryName FROM BNKM.Country
),
AnzsicClass as(
	SELECT AnzsicClassCode,AnzsicClassName FROM BNKM.AnzsicClass
),
JobTitle as(
	SELECT JobTitleId,JobTitleName,FinancialInstitutionId FROM BNKM.JobTitle 
),
CustomerCountryOfCitizenship as(
	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY PeriodStartDate DESC) AS RN, NationalityId, CustomerId FROM BNKM.CustomerCountryOfCitizenship
),
CustomerCountryOfCitizenshipRN as(
	SELECT CCC.NationalityId, CCC.CustomerId FROM CustomerCountryOfCitizenship CCC
    WHERE CCC.RN = 1
	),
Nationality as(
	SELECT NationalityId, NationalityName FROM BNKM.Nationality)



 SELECT DISTINCT BC.CUSTOMERID 
    ,BCTN.TelephoneNumber               AS MobileNumber
    ,BCE.EmailAddress                   AS Email
    ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine1          AS AddressLine1
    ,BLOC.LocationAddressLine2          AS AddressLine2
    ,BCTY.CityName                      AS City
    ,BSTT.StateName                     AS Province
    ,BLOC.LocationZipCode               AS ZipCode
    ,BLOC.CountryId                     AS Country
	,BN.NationalityName                 AS Nationality
    ,BCST.ConsentName                   AS DataPrivacyConsent
    ,BACT.CustomerActionTimestamp       AS LastKYCDate
    ,BC.SuspendedIndicator              AS SuspendedIndicator
    ,BEMP.EmployerName                  AS EmployerName
    ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine1          AS OfficeAddressLine1
    ,BEMP.EmployerAddressLine2          AS OfficeAddressLine2
    ,BCTY2.CityName                     AS OfficeCity
    ,BSTT2.StateName                    AS OfficeProvince
    ,BEMP.ZipCode                       AS OfficeZipCode
    ,BCTRY.IsoCountryName               AS OfficeCountry
    ,BAZC.AnzsicClassName               AS Industry
    ,BJT.JobTitleName                   AS Occupation
    ,BC.SourceSystemCode                AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BC.FinancialInstitutionId          AS FinancialInstitutionId
	into DW.DimCustomer_CRM
    FROM Customer BC
    LEFT JOIN CustomerTelephoneNumber BCTN ON BC.CustomerId = BCTN.CustomerId  AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCTN.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCTN.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN CustomerConsent BCC ON BC.CustomerId = BCC.CustomerId  AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCC.RN = 1--WITH ISSUE PK ON CONSENTID
    LEFT JOIN Consent BCST ON BCC.ConsentId = BCST.ConsentId --CRM
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerId ,CustomerActionTypeId, MAX(CustomerActionTimestamp) AS CustomerActionTimestamp, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode FROM CustomerAction GROUP BY CustomerId ,CustomerActionTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode) BACT ON BC.CustomerId = BACT.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BACT.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN CustomerLocation BCL ON BC.CustomerId = BCL.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCL.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCL.RN = 1--duplicates
    LEFT JOIN Location BLOC ON BCL.LocationId = BLOC.LocationId AND BCL.FinancialInstitutionId = BLOC.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN CustomerEmail BCE ON BC.CustomerId = BCE.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCE.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCE.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN City BCTY ON BLOC.LocationCity = BCTY.CityId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCTY.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN STATE BSTT   ON BLOC.LocationStateId = BSTT.StateId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BSTT.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN CustomerEmployment BCEMP ON BC.CustomerId = BCEMP.CustomerId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BCEMP.FinancialInstitutionId  AND BCEMP.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN Employer BEMP ON BCEMP.EmployerId = BEMP.EmployerId AND BCEMP.FinancialInstitutionId = BEMP.FinancialInstitutionId AND BEMP.RN = 1
    LEFT JOIN City BCTY2 ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BEMP.CityId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCTY2.CityId) AND BCTY2.FinancialInstitutionId = BEMP.FinancialInstitutionId    
    LEFT JOIN STATE BSTT2   ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BEMP.StateId) = convert(varchar,BSTT2.StateId) AND BEMP.FinancialInstitutionId = BSTT2.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN Country BCTRY ON  BEMP.Country = convert(varchar,BCTRY.CountryId) 
    LEFT JOIN AnzsicClass BAZC ON BEMP.AnzsicClassCode = BAZC.AnzsicClassCode 
    LEFT JOIN JobTitle  BJT ON BCEMP.JobTitleId = BJT.JobTitleId AND BC.FinancialInstitutionId = BJT.FinancialInstitutionId
    LEFT JOIN CustomerCountryOfCitizenshipRN BCCC ON BC.CustomerId = BCCC.CustomerId
    LEFT JOIN Nationality BN ON BCCC.NationalityId = BN.NationalityId
    WHERE BC.SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'
    and BC.CustomerId ='R01249371'
